canonical: 每当我想起你,你的慈爱永远在我心,
因为你将悲伤变为欢笑,你总叫我无限怀念,
我不愿再痴迷,情愿走上光明的路,
因为你的话是我路灯,我要一生追随着你。
每当我想起你，为了我流多少的泪，
你忍受了十字架的痛苦，叫我怎能将你忘怀
我不愿再软弱，情愿走上牺牲的路，
因为你的血为我流出，我愿一生奉献于你．
你是百合是沙仑玫瑰，永远开放在我心，你的爱像一片柔和的晨光，我要永远永远赞美你。

canonicalEn: Whenever I think of You, Your steadfast love is always in my heart
Because You turn sorrow into laughter; You always fill me with endless longing
I will be deluded no longer; I will gladly walk the path of light
Because Your word is a lamp to my path I will follow You all my life
Whenever I think of You How many tears You shed for me
You endured the pain of the cross. How could I ever forget You?
I will be weak no longer. I willingly take the path of sacrifice
Because You shed Your blood for me, I long to give my life to You
You are the lily and the rose of Sharon, forever blooming in my heart. Your love is like gentle morning light. I will praise You forever and ever
